sisi.depan: The curved front wall features a massive, circular vault door of polished black metal, its surface displaying an intricate, luminous batik-patterned locking mechanism at the center.
sisi.kanan: To the right, a continuous spiral ramp of dark, polished wood shelves winds up the wall, holding neat rows of glowing, hexagonal record crystals that pulse with a soft internal light.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint is a grand, open archway framed in intricately carved teakwood with gold trim, serving as the main entrance to the archive chamber.
sisi.kiri: To the left, the spiraling wooden shelves continue their ascent, packed with traditional data scrolls in protective cylindrical casings of woven bamboo and polished metal.

tengah: A low, circular data podium made of smooth white stone stands in the center of the floor, its top surface projecting a silent, slowly rotating holographic lattice of light that faces the vault door.
atas: Far above, the spiraling walls converge towards a high, domed ceiling constructed from interlocking panels of dark wood and translucent material, with a central, circular light source casting a focused beam down into the chamber.
